metadata.label: Proveniencia
metadata.description: Record of who or what established the current value of a tracked field of a Learning Element, a Usage, a Backing, or a File, and when. Polymorphic owner (entityType/entityId), one row per entity+field combination. Not a change history: it stores only the provenance of the current value and is overwritten when the field changes, unless the hard rule below blocks the overwrite. Own object of Catalog: it does not reuse the Learning Assurance audit mechanism nor core_DataLog because neither covers agent_ia or seed_propagation, nor captures the actor's role/segment.

entityType.title: Entity Type
entityType.description: Polymorphic owner: same ownerType/ownerId pattern already used by the Learning Assurance object model. CatalogFile added to trace low-confidence identification matches pending curator confirmation (CatalogFile.identificationPending).

entityId.title: Entity
entityId.description: Identifier of the owning entity (LearningElement, Usage, Backing, or CatalogFile, per entityType). Polymorphic reference, no real FK because it points to different tables.

fieldName.title: Field Name
fieldName.description: Name of the tracked field (for example description, cognitiveLevel, rights, evaluationStatus). Unique together with entityType + entityId: a field has at most one current provenance record. Not limited to editorial fields: it also covers automatic diagnostics generated against a versioned configuration, such as evaluationStatus on the Learning Element (a judgment against a rubric, same as cognitiveLevel is a judgment against a taxonomy).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: SeedPropagation is the value when a Usage field was created because it was propagated from a seed dictated course (a template Offering) when a new dictated course was created; if the professor edits it afterward, that field's provenance moves to Person. The concept survives the move from Section to Offering unchanged: what is propagated is the course's usages, and the dictated course is where they live now.

actorId.title: Actor
actorId.description: Who generated or validated the value (core_User id), if origin = Person.

agentIdentifier.title: Agent Identifier
agentIdentifier.description: Which agent or model generated the value, if origin = AiAgent.

actorSegmentId.title: Actor Segment
actorSegmentId.description: Segment of the actor at the time of the action. Relevant to resolve conflicts between segments.

configVersion.title: Config Version
configVersion.description: Taxonomy or configuration in effect when the value was generated, if origin = AiAgent. A configuration change invalidates comparisons between cuts.
